verdict.rationale: Godot documents editor automation through EditorScript, plugins, and headless CLI runs, so asking about versioning and rollback for those automations is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence pack shows no first-party capability to version, review, or roll back automations. Keeping scripts as files under an external VCS would be a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
